_instructions: Copy this template and replace every path, UID and SHA256 placeholder before running.
Paths are relative to this config. Model and case preparation is separate: this harness does not download, encode or export any model.
Each NPZ contains UID__z FP32[1,C,L] and UID__ref FP32[1,1,hop*L], including decoder right padding. The companion JSON has timed_ids in frozen order.
The first metadata timed_id needs at least 17 latent frames. All codec archives must contain identical UIDs and metadata timed_ids.
Meta's fixed watermark_message FP32[1,16] is an NPZ auxiliary array. The graph must include the complete watermarked decoder.
Fill artifact_sha256 with real SHA256 hashes. Add every external_data file and custom library, then freeze the config and pass its hash as --config-sha256.
Select the native model and custom library for the current CPU platform. Use decoder.onnx without custom_library for the portable fallback. Do not label the rewritten fallback audio_stock.
Run with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1 NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=void ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1 before Python imports ORT.
Example: python benchmarks/compare_decoders.py --config comparison.json --config-sha256 REPLACE_WITH_CONFIG_SHA256 --output comparison-results.json --threads 1,4
timing_uids selects the timing cohort only. Full corpus validation remains the default. The two example UIDs are placeholders, not published corpus identifiers.
